critical_findings: Current normalized Product/Variant identity and option-pair shape fits the exact public ikas variant evidence without provider-specific core fields.
Current InventoryObservation is intentionally richer than ikas stockCount evidence; tracking, sellability, policy and freshness must remain unresolved rather than inferred.
Current Order shape can preserve id/orderNumber/orderedAt/status, but totalMoney must not be populated from totalFinalPrice until currency evidence is admitted.
Provider customer PII is retrieval evidence, not customer-disclosure authority; CV0-CV3 remains independent server-side policy.
Webhook boundary correctly requires authenticity + tenant + integration before enqueue; ikas public docs confirm validation/retry/scopes but not enough signature detail for implementation admission.
No core schema expansion is required by the bounded ikas E2 evidence. The primary gaps are adapter evidence/mapping, not normalized-contract redesign.
